# Random workloads (generated by experiments/gen_random_mix.py, seed 2026); part 2/3.
# PREDICTIONS, WRITTEN BEFORE RUNNING (about the hfair design, which was formulated
# after looking at the data it was meant to explain, so it needs a fresh test):
#   M1. Whenever a mix contains an interactive process, hfair and fair give it
#       p95 wake-up latency <= 50 us (they did in every hand-picked workload).
#   M2. hfair's switch count lies between hint's and fair's in every mix, and
#       is never more than 5% above fair's.
#   M3. With wrong hints, hfair's interactive latency stays <= 50 us in every
#       mix, while hint's exceeds 10 ms in at least a third of the mixes that have
#       both CPU-bound and interactive processes.
#   M4. Makespan is within 1% across all policies within each mix.
#   M5. mlfq (default 200 ms boost) has the worst interactive latency of the
#       hint-free policies in most mixes.
# A prediction that fails gets reported as failed.
repeat 3 bench mix:5,0,2 rr
repeat 3 bench mix:5,0,2 mlfq
repeat 3 bench mix:5,0,2 fair
repeat 3 bench mix:5,0,2 hint
repeat 3 bench mix:5,0,2 hfair
repeat 3 bench mix:5,0,2 hfair16
repeat 3 bench mix:5,0,2 hint hints=wrong
repeat 3 bench mix:5,0,2 hfair hints=wrong
repeat 3 bench mix:6,3,3 rr
repeat 3 bench mix:6,3,3 mlfq
repeat 3 bench mix:6,3,3 fair
repeat 3 bench mix:6,3,3 hint
repeat 3 bench mix:6,3,3 hfair
repeat 3 bench mix:6,3,3 hfair16
repeat 3 bench mix:6,3,3 hint hints=wrong
repeat 3 bench mix:6,3,3 hfair hints=wrong
repeat 3 bench mix:2,3,3 rr
repeat 3 bench mix:2,3,3 mlfq
repeat 3 bench mix:2,3,3 fair
repeat 3 bench mix:2,3,3 hint
repeat 3 bench mix:2,3,3 hfair
repeat 3 bench mix:2,3,3 hfair16
repeat 3 bench mix:2,3,3 hint hints=wrong
repeat 3 bench mix:2,3,3 hfair hints=wrong
repeat 3 bench mix:7,2,3 rr
repeat 3 bench mix:7,2,3 mlfq
repeat 3 bench mix:7,2,3 fair
repeat 3 bench mix:7,2,3 hint
repeat 3 bench mix:7,2,3 hfair
repeat 3 bench mix:7,2,3 hfair16
repeat 3 bench mix:7,2,3 hint hints=wrong
repeat 3 bench mix:7,2,3 hfair hints=wrong
repeat 3 bench mix:8,0,1 rr
repeat 3 bench mix:8,0,1 mlfq
repeat 3 bench mix:8,0,1 fair
repeat 3 bench mix:8,0,1 hint
repeat 3 bench mix:8,0,1 hfair
repeat 3 bench mix:8,0,1 hfair16
repeat 3 bench mix:8,0,1 hint hints=wrong
repeat 3 bench mix:8,0,1 hfair hints=wrong
repeat 3 bench mix:7,3,1 rr
repeat 3 bench mix:7,3,1 mlfq
repeat 3 bench mix:7,3,1 fair
repeat 3 bench mix:7,3,1 hint
repeat 3 bench mix:7,3,1 hfair
repeat 3 bench mix:7,3,1 hfair16
repeat 3 bench mix:7,3,1 hint hints=wrong
repeat 3 bench mix:7,3,1 hfair hints=wrong
repeat 3 bench mix:8,3,2 rr
repeat 3 bench mix:8,3,2 mlfq

repeat 3 bench mix:8,3,2 hint
repeat 3 bench mix:8,3,2 hfair
repeat 3 bench mix:8,3,2 hfair16
repeat 3 bench mix:8,3,2 hint hints=wrong
repeat 3 bench mix:8,3,2 hfair hints=wrong
repeat 3 bench mix:5,2,0 rr
